recommendedTextbook.title: New General Mathematics for Senior Secondary Schools 3
recommendedTextbook.author: M.F. Macrae, A.O. Kalejaiye, Z.I. Chima, G.U. Garba

topics.topic: Surds: Simplification, Conjugate Surds and Rationalization of Denominators
subtopics: Definition of surds as irrational roots
Rules of surds: √(ab) = √a × √b and √(a/b) = √a / √b
Rationalizing binomial surd denominators using conjugate pairs: (a + √b)(a - √b)
objectives: Simplify surds to their lowest radical form
Rationalize denominators containing binomial surds with 100% precision

topics.topic: Matrices and Determinants: 2×2 Matrix Inverses and Systems of Equations
subtopics: Definition, order, and algebra of matrices (addition, subtraction, scalar multiplication)
Matrix multiplication rules (row by column)
Determinant and inverse of 2×2 matrices: solving simultaneous equations via matrix inversion
objectives: Compute determinants of 2×2 matrices: det(A) = ad - bc
Find the inverse of non-singular matrices
Solve pairs of linear equations using the matrix inverse method

topics.topic: Arithmetic Progression (AP): Nth Term and Sum of First N Terms
subtopics: Definition of sequences and series, common difference (d), first term (a)
Nth term formula of an AP: T_n = a + (n - 1)d
Sum of first n terms of an AP: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1)d] or n/2 (a + l)
objectives: Calculate the nth term, common difference, and number of terms of an AP
Solve multi-step financial word problems involving increasing annual salaries or savings in Naira

topics.topic: Geometric Progression (GP): Nth Term, Sum and Sum to Infinity
subtopics: Definition of GP, common ratio (r), and nth term formula: T_n = a × r^(n-1)
Sum of first n terms of a GP: S_n = a(r^n - 1) / (r - 1) for r > 1
Sum to infinity for convergent series: S_∞ = a / (1 - r) where |r| < 1
objectives: Determine the common ratio and calculate terms of geometric sequences
Compute the sum to infinity of geometric progressions
Model Nigerian population growth and compound interest trajectories using GP

topics.topic: Coordinate Geometry: Lines, Midpoints, Perpendicularity and Equations
subtopics: Distance between two points: d = √[(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2]
Midpoint formula: [(x_1 + x_2)/2, (y_1 + y_2)/2] and gradient m = (y_2 - y_1) / (x_2 - x_1)
Conditions for parallel lines (m_1 = m_2) and perpendicular lines (m_1 × m_2 = -1)
objectives: Find the equation of straight lines in gradient-intercept form (y = mx + c)
Formulate equations of lines perpendicular to a given line passing through a point

topics.topic: Differential Calculus: Differentiation from First Principles and Power Rule
subtopics: Concept of limits and instantaneous rate of change
Differentiation from first principles: dy/dx = lim(h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)] / h
The power rule: d/dx (x^n) = n × x^(n-1) and differentiation of polynomials
objectives: Differentiate linear and quadratic functions from first principles
Apply standard differentiation rules to evaluate gradients of curves at given points

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & WASSCE Mock Clinic
subtopics: Evaluation on surds, matrices, progressions, coordinate geometry, and basic calculus
WASSCE mock testing and grading
objectives: Assess pupil performance against WAEC Chief Examiner standards

topics.topic: Applications of Differential Calculus: Maxima, Minima and Kinematics
subtopics: Stationary points: setting dy/dx = 0 to find turning points
Distinguishing maximum and minimum points using the second derivative d^2y/dx^2
Kinematics: Velocity as rate of change of displacement (v = ds/dt), Acceleration a = dv/dt
objectives: Calculate maximum profit or minimum cost in economic business optimization models
Solve motion problems determining velocity and acceleration of moving bodies

topics.topic: Integral Calculus: Indefinite and Definite Integrals and Area Under Curves
subtopics: Integration as anti-differentiation: ∫ x^n dx = (x^(n+1) / (n+1)) + c
Evaluating definite integrals between limits a and b
Calculating the area enclosed under a curve: Area = ∫ [f(x)] dx from a to b
objectives: Evaluate indefinite and definite polynomial integrals
Calculate the area bounded by curves, the x-axis, and boundary coordinates

topics.topic: Earth as a Sphere: Longitudes, Latitudes, Great Circles and Nautical Miles
subtopics: Lines of latitude (parallels) and lines of longitude (meridians)
Great circles (equator, meridians) vs small circles (parallels of latitude: radius r = R Cos α)
Distance along lines of longitude and latitude in kilometers (R = 6400 km) and nautical miles
objectives: Calculate shortest distances between international airports and Nigerian cities on the globe
Compute time differences between different longitudes (15° = 1 hour)

topics.topic: Statistics: Variance and Standard Deviation of Grouped Data
subtopics: Review of mean, median, and mode for grouped frequency distributions
Mean deviation formula: MD = ∑f|x - x̄| / ∑f
Variance and Standard Deviation: s = √[ (∑f(x - x̄)^2) / ∑f ]
objectives: Construct complete grouped frequency tables with class boundaries and midpoints
Calculate variance and standard deviation accurately for examination mark scores

topics.topic: Cumulative Frequency (Ogive): Median, Quartiles and Percentiles
subtopics: Constructing cumulative frequency tables and plotting S-shaped ogive curves
Estimating median (Q2), lower quartile (Q1), upper quartile (Q3), and interquartile range
Determining pass marks and top percentile thresholds from the ogive curve
objectives: Plot accurate cumulative frequency graphs against upper class boundaries
Read median and quartile statistics from the ogive with examination precision

topics.topic: Final WASSCE & NECO Mock Examination Clinic
subtopics: Comprehensive 3-year senior secondary mathematics mock examination
Review of Chief Examiner marking rubrics and terminal certification
objectives: Complete senior secondary mathematics graduation certification
